name: Summer Earn and Learn (SEAL) for students with disabilities
org: Texas Workforce Commission, Vocational Rehabilitation, with local workforce boards
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job placement of at least five weeks. You earn a paycheck while learning new skills and gaining work experience.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 22 (and under 22 as of September 1 of the previous year) who get special education services under IDEA or have a disability under Section 504, and who are in an educational program. That includes secondary school, home school and other recognized programs.
pay_detail: Wages for hours worked. Each local board sets one hourly wage for its program. The amount is not stated on the pages read.
duration: At least five weeks of paid work, with at least four hours in a week to count as a week. No more than 40 hours a week.
deadline_text: No dates for summer 2027 are posted on the pages read. It is a summer program. Ask your local office in the fall or winter.
how_to_apply: Contact your local Texas Workforce Solutions Vocational Rehabilitation Services office. Counselors refer current VR participants. Students who have not applied for VR but meet the disability rule may also be candidates. Statewide contact: 512-936-6400 or vr.office.locator@twc.texas.gov.
notes: Only for students with disabilities. Texas child labor hour limits for 14 and 15 year olds still apply. The pages read do not give a posted 2027 timeline.
